exposure: General surgery training in South Africa
Prior experience in OBGYN, ORTHO, and URO before general surgery residency
surgical specialty (general surgery, OBGYN, ORTHO, and URO)
outcome: current competency in GS, OBGYN, ORTHO, and URO humanitarian operations
finding: South African general surgeons are potentially well suited for humanitarian surgery, with most having received training in OBGYN, ORTHO, and URO prior to residency and many maintaining competence in the corresponding humanitarian operations.
mod_finding: 82% of South African general surgeons reported training in cesarean section, and 51% reported competency.
